_readme: Badges (trophies.js). Each badge counts one career stat (saved on the phone, never reset) and has one medal per value in tiers: reach it to earn that medal. desc: {n} is the next tier's value. fmt: how numbers show (km, time). secret: shown as ??? until earned. A tier value of "all" means every kind there is (every enemy type in the levels, every boss, every level). medals: which medal each tier is, from the tiers list below (default: a 1-tier badge is GOLD, 3 tiers BRONZE-SILVER-GOLD, and so on). Every medal is worth its points; points make the rank, and every rank unlocks a glove colour. passive: true = it fills up by itself (time, distance), so it is never suggested as a goal. A stat written "kinds:x" counts how many different x.<something> stats are above zero. cups: every category has a trophy cup that grows as its medals are collected: `at` = the share of the category's medals for each cup level, `points` = what each level is worth, `flameAt` = the level (1 = the first) that unlocks the category's flame, a set of colours for the Slap Wave's fireball [core, hot, flame, deep]. goals: how many badges are chased at once, and the shares of the way to the next medal at which a nudge is shown during play.
